title: Galt remnant
secretHint: Far out in Earth's shadow an old Galt beacon is still calling. Sink the Leviathan by turn 24 to answer it.

missions.title: Night of Knives
missions.hint: Break out: go through both gates at once and run for the magnetic band.

missions.title: Salvage Rights
missions.hint: Grey docks: bring one to zero and it joins you with its machines.

missions.title: The Shepherd
missions.hint: Crabs cross asteroids cheaply but crawl through meteoroids and flux.

missions.title: Iron Garden
missions.hint: Batteries: a Crab sets a Dragon or Hydra down on bedrock, and it never moves again.

missions.title: Vane's Gambit
missions.hint: Railguns and missiles: Vane hides in a magnetic field where beams can't reach.

missions.title: Moraine's Price
missions.hint: A walled depot on bedrock: mecha for the gates, turrets on the railway.

choice.prompt: Queen Moraine offers her raiders and her yards. Her price: a free dock at Olympos when Kessrin falls, and the right to sell whatever flies out of it.

options.label: Take the deal
options.text: Fight beside the cartel against the Directorate depot at Kerberos Rock. Her ships join you, and she will name her price later.

options.label: Refuse
options.text: Turn her down and strike first: sink the cartel fleet at anchor in the Ashfall scrapyard before she can turn on you.

missions.title: The Ashfall Raid
missions.hint: Carriers can't enter asteroids: hunt them down the open lanes.

missions.title: Babylon Run
missions.hint: A magnetic belt runs up to the wreck's stern; mecha can cross the hull, ships can't.

missions.title: Burning Yards
missions.hint: A walled yard on bedrock: bring mecha for the gates and long guns for the turrets.

missions.title: The Gate
missions.hint: Beam-proof lanes: the magnetic corridor leads to the north gate past the Dragon turrets.

missions.title: Vane's Last Stand
missions.hint: Many attackers: Vane's Talos is level 8; surround it in open space, away from the comet's tail.

missions.title: Atmosphere
missions.hint: Fighters and the captured Abaddon: four carriers in an asteroid ring, a strike group hidden in the atmosphere.

missions.title: Olympos Again
missions.hint: Fighters first: three Abaddons wait for your capital ships around the citadel.

missions.title: Kessrin
missions.hint: Magnetic belts lead to the gravity ring's west opening; your Abaddon can end the Leviathan from four hexes.

missions.title: Nineveh
missions.hint: Everything you have, and forty machines of it: three cannon lanes split the field, so never end a move in one; craft must climb the hull to kill the towers.
